owasp_taxonomy: OWASP Top10 for Agentic Applications2026; ASI01–ASI10

ASI01: Execution and network containment limit consequences; no explicit goal-integrity/injection test matrix.
ASI02: Restricted workloads and existing service permissions; no complete tool/argument approval assessment.
ASI03: Private identities, routes and mounts; remote entitlements and identity lifecycle remain separately owned.
ASI04: Pinned dependency transfer, offline validation and review of source builds/hooks; no full agent/MCP provenance assessment.
ASI05: Non-root execution, limited mounts/capabilities and restricted egress constrain execution; they do not prevent all hostile code in writable scope.
ASI06: Private history isolation is described; persisted malicious context, provenance and safe reset are not explicitly assessed.
ASI07: User routing does not establish authenticated agent messages, replay protection or delegated authority.
ASI08: Resource admission and local limits; downstream failure propagation, circuit breaking and end-to-end recovery remain workflow-specific.
ASI09: Explicit sharing and handling responsibilities; misleading output and meaningful human review require workflow tests.
ASI10: Runtime restrictions limit blast radius; autonomous scope drift, detection and containment need explicit tests.
